records_artifact: build/fec-bulk-oppexp/2004/records.jsonl (gitignored and reproducible from the source URL, hash, identifiers, and checked-in parser)
interpretation: These are 27,862 reported itemization rows, not 27,862 unique payments. AMNDT_IND describes whether the containing report was filed as new, amended, or terminating; it does not label the row as a duplicate. All 27,862 committee/report-year/report-type/transaction-ID keys are distinct in the filtered projection, and none spans multiple file numbers. That rules out the claimed 16x amendment-row deduplication within this projection, but does not establish one itemization per underlying payment because memo items, subitemizations, reimbursements, and other reporting structures remain.
allowed_language: The official FEC 2004 operating-expenditure file contained 27,862 reported itemization rows from six source-resolved George W. Bush presidential campaign committees under the checked-in cohort filter. Of those rows, 26,115 came from reports marked amended, 1,746 from reports marked new, and one from a termination report; those indicators are not duplicate-row classifications.

consumption.what_this_is: A reproducible, hash-pinned manifest of one official no-key FEC cycle-file scan against the complete pre-resolved cohort committee set.
consumption.what_this_is_not: A deduplicated transaction ledger, beneficial-interest match, crossing, or finding of wrongdoing.
consumption.copy_ready_caveat: AMNDT_IND describes the containing report, not whether a row is a duplicate. Reported-itemization counts are not unique-payment counts, payee text is not resolved identity, and one cycle does not establish complete cohort coverage.
